title: planner check plugin input
description: Input of the planner:check extension point: which plan to check. The plugin reads the plan data itself from plan_dir (or through plan.py export).

plan_id.description: Id of the plan to check.

short_id.description: Short id of the plan such as PLAN7.

plan_dir.description: Absolute path of the plan folder.

plans_root.description: Absolute path of the plans folder that holds the plan.

project_root.description: Root of the project the plans folder belongs to; null for a folder outside a project.

planner_version.description: Version of the planner module that calls the plugin.

schema_urn_prefix.description: Prefix of the plan schema ids; the plan data follows these schemas.
